title.narrative: 1972 CONVENTION: Strengthening Effective World Heritage Management and Ensuring a More Representative World Heritage List in the Mekong Sub-region

description.narrative: This project aims to further promote and operationalise the Guidance and Toolkit for Impact Assessments in a World Heritage Context, including the recently developed local-language versions, through dissemination, technical advice, and consultations with relevant States Parties. Particular attention will be given to ongoing development projects near World Heritage properties in Thailand and Lao PDR, promoting sustainable heritage management through the application of impact assessment principles and the sharing of good practices. The proejct will also disseminate recently developed two thematic study reports on industrial heritage and natural heritage in Southeast Asia, and encourage States Parties to review and revise their national inventories and Tentative Lists.
